formula.expression: min(100, place type + compactness + homes nearby)

footprint_note: Official HDB footprints. Estimated height = published max_floor_lvl × 2.8 m + 1.3 m roof allowance (the NUS Urban Analytics Lab HDB 3D convention), not a surveyed height. Blocks without a verified storey count stay flat. Non-HDB buildings (role 'city') are grey context from Overture Maps (OpenStreetMap, Microsoft, Google and Esri footprints), raised only where a height or floor count is listed; they never replace an HDB shape.
